channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ryan Saunders | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ryan Saunders from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns on the firing of Ryan Saunders:

“I think for all of us it was shock. The way it came out was shocking... The organization made a move that they felt was best for the organization.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Ryan Saunders, Feb 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Ricky Rubio on the firing of Ryan Saunders:

“A lot of emotions. Our record is what it is. Of course the timing was a little weird... We have attachments and emotions to everything. But we have to move on... I'm going to miss Ryan.”

Ricky Rubio on Ryan Saunders, Feb 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:D'Angelo Russell on Ryan Saunders:

“I feel bad for coach right now. He's not getting a fair shake.”

D'Angelo Russell on Ryan Saunders, Jan 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Tre Jones on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Tre Jones on relationship w/Ryan Saunders:

“He played against my oldest brother, coached Tyus and I was in a team interview with him just the other day. He's always super talkative with me, always super nice and seems really genuine. ... They're headed in the right direction.”

Tre Jones on Ryan Saunders, Sep 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Gersson Rosas on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Dane Moore:Gersson Rosas on Ryan Saunders’ status as interim head coach:

“We’ve begun a process... I’m doing my due diligence. It’s a major objective we want to address.”

Gersson Rosas on Ryan Saunders, May 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Spoelstra on Ryan Saunders:

“I’m rooting for him. I hope he gets this job. I think he deserves it.”

Erik Spoelstra on Ryan Saunders, Apr 5, 2019. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Dane Moore:Rick Carlisle on Ryan Saunders:

“It was pretty special what happened in Oklahoma City, with them being able to win the first game on the road,and the scene in the locker room after that went viral — as it should of. This is gonna be a wild place tonight. No doubt about that”

Rick Carlisle on Ryan Saunders, Jan 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Cole Aldrich on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Former #Twolves center Cole Aldrich on Ryan Saunders taking over as interim head coach:

“Ryan has been a friend since high school. He's going to be a great head coach. He has an unbelievable basketball mind.”

Cole Aldrich on Ryan Saunders, Jan 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @DWolfsonKSTP.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Ryan Saunders
item.description:
Towns:

“A lot. I was talking to him a lot. We sat down a lot, but we didn’t sit down as much as I wished I could have. I spent a lot of time with his son (Ryan Saunders, a Timberwolves assistant coach).I just did everything that I can to make sure that I played as hard for him [Flip]. I was so emotional at the end of the game, because I just remember promising him that I wanted to bring as many wins to this franchise as I can and as much as this franchise can hold. I’m just happy I started my promise out right tonight.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Ryan Saunders, Oct 29, 2015. Source: Los Angeles Times.
